senses.zh_definition: Akina：可用作团体等实体的专名；已有马来文报道将其用作参赛队名，具体所指须结合语境。
senses.en_definition: A proper name, attested as the name of a participating team; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang ditemukan sebagai nama sebuah kumpulan peserta; rujukan khususnya bergantung pada konteks. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 尚未核实为马来语普通词条，不能据此赋予通用词义。专名通常写作 Akina；以下搭配和例句采用队名语境，不表示原始词频数据必然指该队。队名用例见 [DBP《Elemen Seni dan Alam Berpisah Tiada》](https://dewanmasyarakat.jendeladbp.my/2023/10/06/18159/)。

collocations.en: a member of the Akina team

etymology.historical_story: Akina is attested as a team name in a DBP report about a cooking competition associated with a language and arts festival. That occurrence establishes a naming use, but it does not establish the name's linguistic origin or literal meaning. Without further context, a Japanese derivation or any other origin would be speculative. [DBP report](https://dewanmasyarakat.jendeladbp.my/2023/10/06/18159/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Akina 想成队服上的名字：先记住它指谁，再按命名者确认的读音记忆；不要强拆成普通词义。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼个人或团体时尊重其自用拼写和读音；不能仅凭 Akina 推断性别、国籍或族群。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于明确的命名语境。正式名单应核对注册名称；没有上下文时不宜把它当作可自由替换使用的马来语普通名词。
